title: Landplot map creation - Quick and Easy
excerpt: The "Quickland Plot" tool is built on the philosophy of "Design Smarter, Work Faster". It aims to empower users—especially those who may not be experts in complex GIS software—to produce high-quality, standardized land maps quickly while maintaining high data integrity.
tip: The input data can either be existing polygon feature, existing line feature, point boundary, or csv table containing xy coordinate of the boundary.
body:
Tired of spending hours manually drawing boundaries, setting up labels, and designing map layouts? We have the perfect solution for you! In this video, we introduce the "Quickland Plot" tool—a powerful feature of the KGA Toolbox designed to automate your GIS workflow and save you valuable time. ⏱️✨

✅ What can this tool do for you?

Automatic Geometry: Convert your raw data (Points, Lines, or Polygons) into a complete land parcel map instantly.
One-Click Mapping: Just select your input, click "Run," and let the toolbox handle the rest.
Professional Output: Automatically generates layouts, coordinate tables, and symbology with high precision.
Work Smarter: Designed for both GIS experts and those new to the software to produce high-quality results.

Step-by-step guide
steps:
Choose Input type
Specify output workspace
Add map title (optional)
Add address sub-title (optional)
Set grid interval
Choose to open the map
